evidence.note: Unifies text-based and visually-grounded reasoning in one vision-language model and uses RL with a mode-relative advantage to make the model pick which mode to use per input, raising average accuracy over eight benchmarks by about 5 points.
evidence.title: Mixture-of-Visual-Thoughts: Exploring Context-Adaptive Reasoning Mode Selection for General Visual Reasoning

evidence.note: ARES trains multimodal reasoning models to spend exploration effort in proportion to problem difficulty, using sliding-window token entropy as the signal for when and how much to explore.
evidence.title: ARES: Multimodal Adaptive Reasoning via Difficulty-Aware Token-Level Entropy Shaping
